notes: «المعنى» and «واحد» are editor words on the wording of the three names: left out (rule 1)
«عن أبيه» is the Companion who saw the question, named here only by relation: a relation link, the last one
«وقد رواه شعبة عن علقمة بن مرثد أيضا» names another transmitter for the same report: a variant group (rule 4); «قال أبو عيسى» is commentary
